item.title: Tree problems, 6th September
item.description:
This is the fourth year running I have reported trees in Hollyoak wood park which are over hanging my garden fence. These branches are too high for me to cut back. I had a bough earlier in the year in my garden and managed to get it sawn up and disposed of. Now I cannot use my rotary line because the birds are messing on my washing. Apart from the fact that am filling my brown bin with leaves from the trees which I pay for.

item.title: Overgrown weeds obstructing pavement, 6th September
item.description:
There is extensive weed and vegetation growth along the pavement and kerb, which has become very overgrown and is significantly reducing the usable width of the footpath. In several places pedestrians are being pushed towards the road or have to navigate around the overgrowth and wheelie bins. The weeds are also growing through cracks and between paving slabs along a substantial stretch of the street. Please could the pavement and kerb edge be cleared and the vegetation removed, rather than simply trimmed back. Fordel Road on the south side mostly
